data.long_meaning: The name Adalah is derived from the Arabic root 'adl', meaning 'justice'. In Islamic tradition, Adalah is a name given to a righteous and fair individual. It symbolizes the pursuit of justice and fairness in all aspects of life. The name Adalah carries the meaning “Justice” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Adalah usually hope their child will grow to embody justice and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Adalah was the name of the legal code established by the Fatimid Caliphate in Egypt during the 10th century. It is considered to be one of the most comprehensive and influential legal systems in Islamic history. The code was based on the Quran, the Hadith, and the teachings of the Fatimid Imam-Caliph al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah.

historical_references.reference: Adalah also refers to the concept of justice in Islamic law, which includes the idea of equality and fairness. The idea of Adalah has been a fundamental principle of Islamic society throughout history, and continues to be an important concept in contemporary Islamic thought and practice.
